title: Three-step onboarding wizard
describe: an onboarding flow with three steps
prompt:
Build an onboarding wizard at /onboarding with three steps.

Requirements:
- Step 1 has the heading "Your details", a field labelled "Full name" and a button "Next". Pressing Next with the name empty shows "Full name is required" and stays on the step.
- Step 2 has the heading "Pick a plan" and two radio options, "Starter" and "Team", and a button "Next".
- Step 3 has the heading "Review", shows the name and the chosen plan, and a button "Finish".
- Finish shows "You are all set".
- A text "Step <n> of 3" shows where the user is.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
